Trace, implement and test: Consider MxN matrix m1 and PxQ matrix M2 cosisting of positive integers. Create and print outmatrix based ont that below logic.

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
# Consider MxN matrix m1 and PxQ matrix M2 cosisting of positive integers. Create and print outmatrix based ont that below logic.
# For every number num1 from M1 at row r1 and column c1 :
# (1) Multiply with each of the numbers num2 of M2 such that num2 is in (r1,r1) , (r1,c1) , (c1,c1) , (c1,r1) if exists.
# (2) Identify and add the product that occurs maximum number of times to outmatirx at row r1 and column c1.
# (3) If there are multiple product with maximum occurence then minimum value will be added yo row r1 anc column c1.
# (4) if both row and column in M2 doesn't exist equal to r1 and c1 then add -1 in the outmatrix at row r1 and column c1.


from collections import Counter
try:
    m = int(input())
    n = int(input())
    a = []
    for i in range(m):
        a.append(list(map(int, input().split())))
    lm = len(a[0])
    b = []
    for i in range(n):
        b.append(list(map(int, input().split())))
    ln = len(b[0])
    ans = [[-1 for _ in range(lm)] for _ in range(m)]
    for i in range(m):
        for j in range(lm):
            flag = 0
            tmp = []
            # print('i ',i)
            # print('j ',j)
            # print('ln ',ln)
            # print('n ',n)
            # ln -column length b array
            # n - row length of b array
            if (i < ln and i < n):
                tmp.append(a[i][j]*b[i][i])
                flag = 1
            if (i < ln and j < n):
                tmp.append(a[i][j]*b[j][i])
                flag = 1
            if (j < ln and i < n):
                tmp.append(a[i][j]*b[i][j])
                flag = 1
            if (j <ln and j < n):
                tmp.append(a[i][j]*b[j][j])
                flag = 1
            # print('tmp ',tmp)
            if flag == 1:
                tc = Counter(tmp)
                val = 0
                # print('tc ',tc)
                for k in tc.keys():
                    val = max(tc[k],val)
                tp = []
                for k in tc.keys():
                    if tc[k] == val:
                        tp.append(k)
                print('tp ',tp)
                ans[i][j] = min(tp)
    for i in range(m):
        print(*ans[i])
except EOFError as e:
    pass
